# AxiomEmbedded

Use `AGENTS.md` as the repository contract. Prefer indexed/context-selected
reads over repository-wide loading and preserve the project
evidence/traceability model.

## Entry points

- MCP server: `python -m axiom_cli mcp` (tools: engage, run_plan,
  read_skill, list_skills, list_profiles, context_select, impact, ...)
- CLI: `axiom engage|run|analyze|graph|context|impact|status|fix|feature`
  (or `python -m axiom_cli ...` without install)
- REST/A2A: `axiom serve --port 8931`

Ships 58 skills (see `registries/skills.json`), axiom-embedded 0.2.0.
